_comment: Great Glacite waypoints config - edit this file to customize Great Glacite waypoints.
_howToUse: This file is valid JSON. Do not use // or /* */ comments. Use keys like _comment or _guide if you want to leave notes.
After editing this file, run /bza reload (or re-enter the area / restart the game) to apply changes.
Each object inside 'waypoints' is one Great Glacite waypoint.
name is the label shown above the waypoint (default: Great Glacite).
pos is the main waypoint box in [x, y, z]. size is the box edge length (default 1.0).
secondary is an optional second box in [x, y, z], shown when you are within 5 blocks of pos. secondarySize is its box edge length (default 0.5).
rgb is the color in [red, green, blue]. Example: [0, 255, 255].
